I added the sentence, but I can't confirm the build: the compile ran and exited cleanly, but no PDF appeared in the preview.

- **Edit:** "Field work ran from 6 to 24 October." is now at the end of line 4 of `sections/introduction.tex`, right after the `\cite{stephenson2013}.` that closes the paragraph. Your `% person note` lines are still there.
- **Compile:** LuaLaTeX ran twice. The first run's log showed EXITCODE 0 and "No compilation issues", and the status bar says "Compiled · 0 warnings". Both times the preview went back to "Make your ideas tangible." and the status bar reads "pages unavailable · source changed, compile again". It probably flags that because you kept typing during the compile (the notes went from 1 to 13). I didn't compile a third time, since your typing would likely trigger the same flag.

**My mistake:** My first attempt replaced the whole contents of `introduction.tex` with just the new sentence. I undid it straight away with Ctrl+Z, and the file came back as it was, including your notes. If your own undo history in that tab looks odd, that's why.

Once you pause typing, press Compile (Ctrl+Enter) to get the PDF.
